disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is not based on security findings but on a tool failure. The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 error during the full PKGBUILD audit, resulting in an inconclusive verdict, whereas the deepseek model completed the audit successfully and found no issues.
learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) should trigger automatic retries rather than immediately failing the file audit and forcing an inconclusive package verdict.
